synthesizedFacts.fact: Doxycycline is a second-generation tetracycline used in the treatment of rosacea, particularly effective for inflammatory lesions such as papules and pustules.
Doxycycline is often prescribed in subantimicrobial doses to reduce inflammation without the antibiotic effects.
ORACEA, a brand of doxycycline, is specifically formulated to treat the inflammatory lesions of rosacea and is not effective for reducing facial redness.
Rosacea is a chronic condition with a higher prevalence in fair-skinned individuals, often requiring long-term management.
Common side effects of doxycycline include gastrointestinal issues and potential photosensitivity, although the latter was not observed in clinical trials for ORACEA.
